kurz: More fat makes things more tender, moister and richer, but also softer and more prone to spreading.
bild_im_kopf: A dial between a bread roll and a butter biscuit.
was_passiert: Fat coats flour and slows the [[glutenbildung|gluten network]]. It holds moisture and carries aromas. Too much fat makes baked goods spread or turn greasy.
faustregeln: Replacing fat is tricky: apple purée instead of butter makes cake tougher and rubbery.

params.rechts: lots of fat: tender, short, rich
